title: Distinguish retryable task-sync holds from permanent dependent refusals
outcome: Folder receipts classify a dependent as held only when its actual blocking cause is retryable local execution or reconciliation; permanent ancestor or identity refusals remain refused.
acceptance: A sealed-completed ancestor and a dependency on an id_collision or origin_graph refusal report Refused with the causal reason
A live claim, engaged root or reconciliation hold propagates Held through dependent additions, with tests
